summary: Pages stay fast after every run.

fixes.title: Pages stay fast after every run
fixes.text: At the end of every run, SecurityInsight prepares the database for fast pages, so pages never wait while you look. If this cannot run, the run still completes.

fixes.title: Device close-loop list opens quickly
fixes.text: A device's close-loop list now reads only that device's findings. It could take more than a minute before.

fixes.title: New installations keep pages from waiting
fixes.text: New installations keep the database prepared in the background, so reading a page never waits.
